-- The proof-shape ratchet's red control.
--
-- Appended to a LIBRARY source whose pinned `first` ceiling in `generated/proof-shape.tsv` is
-- zero, the gate parses the file, counts one `Lean.Parser.Tactic.first` node, finds it above the
-- ceiling, and refuses (the six-minute self-test that planted it was retired 2026-09-19; the
-- fixture stays as the shape's record). A binder or a pattern named `first` is not a node of that kind and is not counted,
-- which is the other half of the rule.
example : True := by
  first
    | trivial
    | exact True.intro
